description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the 'EmpWorkExperience' entity related to employee work experience in the OrangeHRM system. It sets up test data, creates instances of employee and work experience, persists them, and asserts the correctness of entity behavior and data integrity.

classes.name: EmployeeWorkExperienceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the Employee Work Experience entity related to an employee, including creation, persistence, and data verification.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by truncating specific database tables related to employee and work experience entities.

methods.name: testEmployeeWorkExperienceEntity
methods.description: Creates an Employee entity, sets its attributes, persists it, then creates an EmployeeWorkExperience entity, associates it with the Employee, sets its attributes, persists it, retrieves it from the database, and asserts that all attributes are correctly stored and retrieved.
